# Sources

Use stable IDs such as S001. Inline citations in report files should link to these source URLs.

| Source ID | Provider / retrieval method | Title | Publisher | URL | Publish/update date | Event/observation date | Access date | Geography/population | Industry/category | Source tier/type | Primary/secondary | Fetched / status (full page / snippet only / source access failed / command failed / status unknown / not attempted) | Claims supported | Independence cluster | Corroborates / contradicts | Limitations |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Use "source access failed" only when the provider returned a source-specific access denial or equivalent. Keep malformed command/configuration errors as "command failed; retry eligible", provider/network failures without source-specific results as "source status unknown", and untouched URLs as "not attempted". Preserve attempt history and concise failure reasons. These states are coverage limitations, never evidence of absence. Do not classify a row as snippet-only because the word appears in its limitations or title; use only the fetched/status field.
